observations: Photo 0: A car drivetrain/engine assembly on the ground, showing two bell-housing areas with circular clutch/flywheel-like plates and a large gearbox casing; wiring and hoses are visible; heavy grime and rust on metal surfaces.
Photo 1: Close-up of the underside/side of the engine/gearbox area with multiple electrical connectors and colored wires (red/blue/orange) hanging near ports; metal is dusty/dirty.
Photo 2: Wider view of the engine/gearbox assembly with many hoses, wiring harnesses, and metal brackets; no clear exterior body panels; surfaces look used with dirt and wear.
